_comment: Written by hand to stand in for a model's answer on screen 7301. It is not model output. It mixes five exact quotes with one claim for each drop rule, so the demo shows every way a claim gets dropped.

claims.quote: At my last job I wrote the telemetry decoder for our test stand myself.
I traced it to the clock on the logging board and fixed it with a resync step.
I ran it on the bench for three days and compared every frame against a reference recorder.
I sat with them during two campaigns, and they asked for a plain-text summary at the end of each run, so I added one.
I want to work on software that flies, close to the hardware, with the people who test it.
The technicians said I was the best engineer they had worked with.
Tell me about something you built yourself, start to finish.
When the timestamps drifted by a few milliseconds per hour
I'd like to stay in Orange County, my kids are in school here.
That is the part of my job I like most.
